blocks.text: West Newton homes listed and sold, June to September 2026

West Newton, September 2026. Detached houses: 83 listed at month end and 17 sold in September, a sales ratio of 20% (a balanced market). Condos and townhomes: 130 listed at month end and 8 sold in September, a sales ratio of 6% (a buyers’ market).

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Looking across the period, Detached houses: 43 sold over 4 months against an average of 96.8 listed, about 9.0 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was September with 17 sold. Condos and townhomes: 33 sold over 4 months against an average of 125.0 listed, about 15.2 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was July with 13 sold.

faq.q: How did West Newton sell in September 2026?
faq.a: Detached recorded 83 active listings, 17 solds and a 20% sales ratio — the highest detached ratio of all 15 Surrey sub-areas that month — while Condos & Townhomes recorded 130 listings, 8 solds and a 6% ratio; medians are published at community level only (Surrey detached $1,215,000; attached $512,944) (as of September 2026, Source: SnapStats FVR/GVR September 2026 report).

The R1 RapidBus on King George Boulevard (Newton Exchange to Guildford Exchange), the R6 Scott Road RapidBus on the west edge (Scott Road Station to Newton Exchange), and routes 323 and 364 through the area — two RapidBus corridors connecting to Expo Line stations.

faq.q: Can a West Newton lot have more units?
faq.a: Under Surrey's SSMUH rules, up to 3 units on lots under 280 m², 4 units on lots over 280 m², and up to 6 units on eligible lots of 281 m² or more within 400 m of a frequent bus stop; one secondary suite per dwelling unit is capped at 40% of the principal unit's habitable floor area, and a coach house or garden suite runs 35–75 m².

faq.q: Is West Newton in a floodplain or the ALR?
faq.a: The residential upland is outside the Serpentine & Nicomekl lowland floodplain, which lies to the south and is dyke-protected; the south end of the plan area falls toward those lowlands, and a specific property's flood and ALR status must be checked on the City's flood mapping and the Agricultural Land Commission's maps.
